Marak Chapa kachenga : 2008 Pala : - Printed at : - Panthi Offset Printers, Sukbir Bhawan, Tura - 794001 --- Page 7 --- Agandapani Anga Achik ongeba A-chik A-songni buring bolgrimrangni bidingo, a'dokni matburingrangni aro do-orangni gimin u-ianio ja manchakbea.
Ila angni bilgrianiko u-ieba, Pa Llewellyn R.
Marak Pangrakpa, uni tarigiminko name poraie nion, rokomari chanchianirang, gisik raatpilanirang aro gisikni re-ani a'palona nakatna seksektokaha.
Do-o matrang A-chikrangni janggi tanganio chapchapbate donggiparang ong'a.
A.chik A songni nitoaniko janapode, do-o matrangni bang'ani aro rokomari ong aniko janapatgijan ong ja.

Skangtalan do-o matrang A.chikrangni janggi tanganio bilmanbea; aganritinganirango, golporango aro katta A chik A-songo do-orang bang:beoba aro an'chingni janggi tanganio uarang mongsonggipa bakko raoba, uarangni jat-ma'mal, dongani cha'ani, bima bipa joraani, bitip dakani aro uarang gita bidingrango am'e sandie niani aro see donanirang dongja. Do-onamangmang gisik on'aigipa manderang an'chingni gisepo nakatkuja.
Gipin a'songrango do-orangko ja-rikbite,jako derbin ra'e dongramtango donggipa do-orangko ma'mal sandie nigiparang ba bird watcher-rang donga.
Bird-bath ba auchakaniko, bird-houseko ba bitchi chichakaniko aro bird-tableko ba cha'ani gatchake dongipako rike ona.
Do-orangni cha'gipa bite- bitchilrangko katepe pala.
Chinaode do-rong bitipo angipa atta dakgipaoniko soup tarigipakon mingsingpila.
Sandie nigiparang bol gadoe bitipni bidingo bitchini bidingo u-idape ra'na jotton ka'a.
Badiaba adoko nikronggipa do-orangko nikangjahaon, duk onga; bilsigipino bilbataiako nikon, bi-sa atchiana kusi ong'a gita gisik katchatoka.

Ku'minchi senokgiparang bird-song ba bird-call, chong'motan do-o mikoaoniko aro uni bewaloniko an'saoataniko nisengsoa. Mandena ka-dongsoani, an'saoani aro gisik an'senganiko on'gipa ia do-orang an'ching gisiko u-ina skanirangkoba nakatata.
Badia do-orang sin-kario bachina apjitanga?
Sagalko batsoto nengjama aro ramako maidake u-ia?
Maiko cha'e knatobee ring'na changa?
Ring'ani apsanaiora, sandidape ra'ode gimikan nambegen.
Ia ki-tapo, Korokni do-o rokomprakko goe, chimonge, New Yorkni National Museumona watatna tarianiko janapa.
Ia chasongode do-o-rangko goe siatna onjajok., Dikdiksana jadipchangatgipa samrangko jakkale, a'doktang - dongramatangon do-orangni bidingo sandianirangkosa da'ororo daka.

Indiba Korokni do-orangko jarike, dongani - cha'ani aro gipin bewalrangko sandie nianiara ramram kam ongja. Korokni sandie see rakkianiko aro ia ki-tapo seaniko poraie, anga chonmitingni salrangko nikjagringatpila.
Attamo do-bret bilraprapa, sarao do-kru saru jrakjrak, songreo dogrik do-mesal katsuseta; do-amek mikoode sokgipana nichaka; do-uang mikoode an'tesrenga.
Do-de alabokni aro Dodikeni gitko do-orangni bimingrangmangmangba saksano chanchie ka dingsimitata.
Indiba, da ode maidakesa uarangni mikoarangko knajaengjok ine chanchibaon, katchani dimelangpila.
--- Page 8 --- Skang chasongode do-deba dongachim ine Korok aro ia ki-tapko segipa janapa.
Ia do-orangni gimaangenganiara jajrenganiko ra-baa.
Do-o mat donggijagipa a:gilsakko chanchiate nibo.

Walni andalanian chotchanggja gita, srik ritik gopramo donga gitasa, a-gilsako janggitanganide ong aignok.,A gilsaktangko ia obostaona sokatna sikjaode, an-ching do-o matrangko ripingna rikna nangskagnok. Ma-a paarang dedrangko batilchi, air-gunchi do-o goramrame roaniko dakjachina ku'pattina nanggen.
Ma'gitcham pagitchamrangde cha'nasa do-o mat goa; an'sengnade ong ja.
Pa Llewellyn-ni kitap do-orangni bidingo u-ie ra'na an-chingna chol on'a.
Ian rama bakchatani, buring o-sapanisa.
Chasong gitalni chadamberangna rama ja-kol ja-rikna ia ki-tap mesoka.
Pa Llewellyn, kitaprangko poraie aro an-tangan buring nape a-bri chiring doe sandie niesa ia ki-tapko sea ine nikna man-a.
Noksarangko sale mesokani gimin do-orangni jat - ma-malko u-ie ra pana ua an-chingna chol ong-a.

A.chik Asongni bol wa-arang, matburingrang aro na'tokrangni biding aro gipin katta bichongrangko ra'e sea - jotanirangko dakdapangkuna una Nokgipa chol aro be'enni an'senganiko on'angkuchina. Ia ki-tapna Aganpaaniko dakna angna on-ahanina, anga Pangrakpako mittelbea.
Dated, Tura.
Sd/- The 3rd January 2006 (Ma Brucellish K.
Sangma) Retd.
Director, DERT.

--- Page 10 --- NING·O SEGIMINRANG Do-rong, Do-rong rokomsa, Paragetget, Do-chiong, Apingga 17 2.

Sarengki, Apingga ma jatchi, Do-kua chiring 18 Do-pa nokma, Do-kua ang:kegrong, Saru bapma, Saru rokomsagipa, Saru a'pal rokomsa, Saru chirek ba a'pal, Moena ba do-sing, Do-mangganchi, Do-ka sa'mik 3.

Re-chim do-ka, Madagogret, Do'memang, Do-pinchep rokomsa 19 Do-maski, Do-kongsi sko gipok, Do'maski dobodot, Do'mandal Do-rekro ba do,jinma 4. Do'rekro rokmosagipa, Do'rekro sko gipok, Do'maski gita 20 dakgipa, Korabok, Do-si rokomsa, Do-pinchep romoksa, Do-pinchep do-wajak, Do-pasi nengkakbal, Do'pasi rimit 5.

Do'pasi sko rimit, Ting do-owarong, Do'pakal ba 21 do'panggal, Rokomsagipa do'panggal, Do-akinte rokomsa Rokom gipin do-akinte, Do-pinchep bibal bitchi opgipa, Do-sokkel (me-kin bitchi opgipa), Do-pinchep miktok, Chanchura ba dosi a'pal, Do-chok 6.
Me-kin bitchi ringgipa, Do-bibal gitchak ba do-challanggi, 22 Do'sokkel ki-me tangsim, Do'pit gitchak, Do'pit chengbrim, rokomsa, Rokom gipin do-si 7.
Do-bret mapil, Do-bret wa-cheksi, Do-bret Kasi, 23 Do-bret chiring, Do-bret bolgrim, Do-bret mandal, Do-bret rimit, Do-bret tangsek, Do-bret dambe rong, Do-bret kalpit, Naorong do-o ba do'saldare.
Do-patchi, Do-bekrot gisim dal-gipa, Do-bekrot chengbrim, 24 Do-bekrot ka-bak tangsimkbit, Do-bekrot rokom gipin.
Do-bekrot rokom gipin, Do-amik, Do-mesal, Do-grik, 25 Do-rerap, Do-de.
Do-kruni jat : Dorek, Do-kru rongge, Do-kru kaldek, Do-kru 25 mande, Do'pilgim, Do-kru a-sim, Paroa, Do'sik ba Batdo
